description: Step 3: a ready-to-sign transaction manifest. Kinds: create-caper, buy, sell, swap, create-proposal, vote, count, trigger, resolve, execute, activate-upgrade, exit, withdraw-founder, transfer-founder. Per-kind parameters – create-caper: name, cashtag, description, infoUrl?, iconUrl?, originToken? (resource address, vampire launch); buy: cashtag, xrd ($XRD to spend); sell: cashtag, tokens (caper tokens to sell); swap: from, to (cashtags), tokens (of `from` to sell) – one transaction that sells `from` into $XRD and buys `to` with it, so it pays the skim on both legs; create-proposal: cashtag, title, description, action (one action object, or an array of up to 4 the voters rank against an appended "Do nothing"; each { kind: "PAYOUT" | "INVEST" | "DIVEST" | "UPGRADE" | "METADATA" | "DEBATE", … }; METADATA rewrites the token's mutable metadata via metadataDescription/metadataIconUrl/metadataInfoUrl, at least one; DEBATE is a non-executable debate position, title and description only, terminal at the tally). Creation costs the proposal fee – 1% of the largest option's $XRD-equivalent amount, at least 500 $XRD – banked to the treasury and kept on pass or fail; vote: cashtag, proposalId (the P-… code), sequence (ranked on-chain option indexes, best first, including the trailing "Do nothing" index); count: cashtag, proposalId (the P-… code) – returns `manifests`, one or a volley to send at once; trigger, resolve: cashtag, proposalId (the P-… code); execute: cashtag, proposalId (the P-… code); for an UPGRADE this is step one of two, which records the candidate in the registry and starts its timelock; activate-upgrade: cashtag, proposalId (the P-… code) – step two of an UPGRADE, valid once the registry timelock lifts; refused before then with the time it lifts; exit: cashtag, votes? and tokens? (vote tokens to burn and caper tokens to sell, each defaulting to your whole balance) – one transaction that burns the vote tokens for your share of the treasury and sells the caper tokens back to the curve; withdraw-founder: cashtag – claims every accrued founder-fee leg, $XRD and caper tokens, to the founder badge's holder; transfer-founder: cashtag, recipient (account), withdrawAccrued? (default true: claim the accrued legs to you first; false leaves them to the recipient) – deposits the founder badge with the recipient. Here create-proposal's action rides as actionJson, a JSON string – e.g. '{"kind":"PAYOUT","title":"Grant","currency":"<resource>","amount":100,"recipient":"<account>"}'. Governance is two-phase: 'vote' casts a ranked ballot (sequence = on-chain option indexes incl. the trailing Do-nothing, best first) during the voting window; once it closes, 'count' tallies it (it returns `manifests`, an array to send at once); a supermajority pass arms 'trigger', which locks the trailing TWAP as the baseline and opens the market window; after the window 'resolve' freezes the verdict (the winner stands unless the TWAP over that window is below the baseline) and 'execute' runs a ratified winner, an UPGRADE in two steps: 'execute', then 'activate-upgrade' once the registry timelock lifts. These cranks cost nothing beyond the network fee, and anyone can call them. You sign and submit the manifest yourself with your own key, then register the txHash with submit_tx. Requires the Bearer token from the `login` tool, sent as an HTTP `Authorization: Bearer <token>` header on the POST carrying this call.

account.description: Your account address (pays fees, receives tokens)

actionJson.description: create-proposal: JSON for the action(s) – either ONE object, or an ARRAY of up to 4 that the voters rank against each other (a "Do nothing" option is always appended, so 4 actions make a 5-option ballot). Each is { kind: "PAYOUT" | "INVEST" | "DIVEST" | "UPGRADE" | "METADATA" | "DEBATE", … }. METADATA rewrites the token's mutable metadata (metadataDescription / metadataIconUrl / metadataInfoUrl – at least one). DEBATE is a non-executable position in a debate: title and description only, and winning it ends the proposal at the tally.

from.description: swap: the cashtag of the caper token you sell

iconUrl.description: create-caper: optional icon URL (defaults to a generated one)

originToken.description: create-caper: optional origin-token resource address (vampire launch)

proposalId.description: vote and every crank after it: the proposal's P-… code

recipient.description: transfer-founder: the account that receives the founder badge

sequence.description: vote: ranked on-chain option indexes, best first — a full permutation including the trailing "Do nothing" index

to.description: swap: the cashtag of the caper token you buy

tokens.description: sell / swap / exit: caper tokens to sell (exit: defaults to your whole balance)

votes.description: exit: vote tokens to burn (defaults to your whole balance)

withdrawAccrued.description: transfer-founder: claim the accrued founder fees to you first (default true); false leaves them to the recipient
